title: Generate initial structures
action: Create the buckled tetragonal unit cells of MgS and MgSe monolayers based on the geometry described in the paper (two Mg atoms and two X atoms per cell, Mg in the middle plane and X atoms buckled outward).
description: Set up the input structural models for subsequent DFT relaxations.

title: Geometry optimization and total energy (PBE)
action: Perform DFT relaxation of the unit cells with PBE functional to obtain the fully optimized lattice constants, atomic positions (buckling distance, bond lengths, bond angles), and the ground-state total energy of each unit cell.
description: Relax atomic coordinates and cell parameters to yield the equilibrium structures.

title: Isolated atom energy calculations
action: Compute the total energy of isolated Mg, S, and Se atoms using the same DFT functional (PBE) and a large enough supercell to avoid interactions.
description: Obtain reference energies for cohesive-energy evaluation.

title: PBE band structure calculation
action: On the optimized equilibrium structures, compute the electronic band structure with the PBE functional to obtain the indirect band gap and band-edge character.
description: Determines the semiconductor nature and PBE gap for the zero-strain case.

title: HSE06 band structure calculation
action: Recalculate the band structure on the optimized structures using the Heyd–Scuseria–Ernzerhof screened hybrid functional (HSE06) to obtain the more accurate band gap.
description: Yields the HSE06 band gap required for zero-strain gap report and summary table.

title: Structural and cohesive energy summary
action: Collect the optimized structural parameters, compute the cohesive energy from the unit-cell and isolated-atom total energies, and report together with the HSE06 band gap.
description: CSV file containing lattice constant, buckling distance, bond length, cohesive energy, and HSE06 band gap for both MgS and MgSe.
output_schema: Columns: Material, Lattice_constant_a(Angstrom), Buckling_delta(Angstrom), Bond_length_MgX(Angstrom), Cohesive_energy(eV/atom), HSE06_band_gap(eV). Rows: MgS, MgSe.

title: Zero‑strain band gap report
action: Report the PBE and HSE06 band gaps for MgS and MgSe in a JSON file.
description: JSON object with keys MgS and MgSe, each containing objects with keys PBE_gap(eV) and HSE06_gap(eV).

title: Strain‑dependent DFT calculations (PBE)
action: For each biaxial strain value from -8% to +8% in steps of 2%, modify the lattice constant accordingly and re‑compute the total energy and PBE band structure for both materials.
description: Systematic simulation of strain effect on electronic structure.

title: Strain‑dependent band gap table
action: Extract the PBE band gap for each strain and each material into a CSV table.
description: CSV with columns: Material, Strain_percent, PBE_band_gap(eV). Rows for each material and each strain from -8 to +8 in steps of 2.
output_schema: Columns: Material, Strain_percent, PBE_band_gap(eV). Rows for all strain values.

title: Optical properties calculation (dielectric function)
action: On the unstrained equilibrium structures, compute the momentum‑matrix‑element‑based imaginary dielectric function and then obtain the real part via Kramers‑Kronig transformation. Derive absorption coefficient and reflectivity spectra.
description: Full optical response calculation for the out‑of‑plane (ZZ) direction.

title: Dielectric function of MgS
action: Export the real and imaginary parts of the dielectric function for MgS as a function of energy.
description: CSV with columns: Energy_eV, real_eps_ZZ, imag_eps_ZZ. Energy range from 0 to at least 15 eV with adequate resolution.

title: Dielectric function of MgSe
action: Same as step_11 but for MgSe.
description: CSV with columns: Energy_eV, real_eps_ZZ, imag_eps_ZZ.

title: Absorption and reflectivity of MgS
action: From the MgS dielectric function, derive the optical absorption coefficient and reflectivity spectrum and save to CSV.
description: CSV with columns: Energy_eV, absorption_coeff_cm-1, reflectivity_fraction.

title: Absorption and reflectivity of MgSe
action: Same as step_13 but for MgSe.
description: CSV with columns: Energy_eV, absorption_coeff_cm-1, reflectivity_fraction.
